cohort: 700 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes mellitus in the US from 2004 to 2017
finding: While obstetric guideline changes may have improved gestation length and mode of delivery, excessive gestational weight gain, macrosomia, and large for gestational age remained unchanged in pregnant women with type 1 diabetes
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries increased over the study period
birth_weight: no change in birthweight over time
